content:
I'm trying to better understand the process of (1) automating the process of generating rules for a greedy process, and (2) checking closure of a set of rules. Looking back at old discussions, there were some very long, impressive lists of rules. I have a specific example in mind, where I think I now have a full set of rules needed for greedy choices, but checking it is closed is becoming painful.

(I am very comfortable working with Vampire, slightly less so with Prover9, if those ATPs can help me.)
